tensions: The weight cap is being satisfied in letter and defeated in spirit: no position exceeds 25%, yet LINK + XLM + ONDO + the proposed AAVE and QNT are one trade wearing five tickers. Second tension: LTC is +37.4% at 28 days held, past the 21-day dead-money line but nowhere near dead — negative funding on a +42% month with 90% Bloomberg ETF odds is the single best risk/reward in the book, and the rules have no language for a winner that is also old. Third: QNT scores 6/9 and the rulebook says fund it at $200; the two failing signals are founder distribution and the absence of any base, which are precisely the two that decide whether a momentum entry survives. Scoring treats all nine signals as equal. They are not.

opening.text: Eight positions, eight green. That is not skill, that is a tide — BTC dom 58.7% and grinding up means the alt bid is borrowed, not earned. F&G 72. Portfolio +49.2% on $1,331 deposited. Enjoy it and distrust it.

AAVE is the trade. 8 of 9 signals: V4 past $1B deposits with 81.7% TVL growth, Base Equities Hub taking tokenized COIN as collateral, a $50M institutional lending proposal, Kulechov floating a burn in Aavenomics 3.0, a $4.26M whale buy, and volume/mcap at 23.3% — the deepest liquidity in the whole screen. And it is still 72% below its all-time high. Everything else on the board is asking me to pay up for a move that already happened.

QNT at $100 and not a dollar more, and by limit at $235 rather than market at $250. The Clearing House clearing more than half of US ACH and wire is as real a catalyst as this asset class produces. But the founder wallet moved $6.97M into a 5x. Insiders selling into a parabola is the oldest tell there is. The momentum rule says do not veto for being extended; it says nothing about ignoring the people who built the thing taking money off the table. So we bid below, and we are content to miss.

The honest risk in this book is concentration of theme, not of ticker. LINK, ONDO, XLM, QNT, AAVE — that is five bets on the same sentence: institutions tokenize things in 2026. At 20.8% + 18.3% + 14.1% plus two new entries, the RWA/institutional-plumbing cluster is most of the portfolio. No single weight breaks 25%, so the rulebook is satisfied and the actual exposure is not. LTC and BTC are the only genuinely uncorrelated legs. If the tokenization narrative takes a month off, this book draws down as one position.
